products.name: Flux Encoder
products.description: Queue, inspect and encode media with hardware-aware FFmpeg profiles.

entries: Synchronized package and suite metadata for the v0.8.18 alpha development release.
Uses the suite-owned rendering interfaces when receiving Flux Motion export jobs.

products.name: Flux Motion
products.description: Design broadcast graphics, titles and motion scenes in one focused workspace.

entries: Eliminated the multi-minute first-render freeze by keeping ordinary 2D layer copies on a compact GPU shader and loading advanced lighting/shadow code only when a 3D lit layer needs it.
Added a real-layer GPU startup smoke test covering both initial shader compilation and compositor readback.
Retained the native Chart, adaptive playback, Welcome screen and cache improvements from the v0.8.19 alpha release.

products.name: Flux Motion Plugin for OBS
products.description: Cue and render Flux Motion projects directly inside OBS Studio.

entries: Eliminated the OBS graphics-thread freeze caused by multi-minute compilation of unused 3D lighting and shadow shader code.
Registered the legacy Broadcast Graphics Live source identifier so existing OBS scenes continue to load after the obsolete plugin is removed.
Retained the shared native Chart renderer, host resolution/frame-rate handling and deterministic cache behavior from v0.8.19 alpha.
